newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling gains on dlr, pound.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling gains on dlr, pound.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling made further gains against the dollar on Wednesday in the absence of any significant demand amid heavy inflows from agricultural exporters, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.64 against the dollar from 54.90 on Tuesday while against the pound it was posted at a mean rate of 91.22 from 91.60.
"I think what's happening now is a correction. There is no demand at the high levels of 55," a dealer said.
The money market remained slightly liquid with overnight rates quoted at 11 percent from Tuesday's 8-11 percent.
